premises.text: Teams juggle PowerPoint, email, Slack, Dropbox/Drive, and separate present/share tools, which ruins formatting and versions
premises.evidence_span: Someone uploads it to Dropbox or Google Drive. Someone else has the wrong version of PowerPoint. It totally ruins the formatting

premises.text: Slides replaces that stack with one end-to-end create–present–share platform and a new structure for presentations
premises.evidence_span: We have an entirely new format for how you structure your presentations

premises.text: Live embeds, collaboration, team templates, and device-agnostic presenting are delivered inside that single product
premises.evidence_span: Slides makes it incredibly easy to include live content like this from any service

premises.text: Commercial model includes free use plus paid individual, team, and Enterprise firewall offerings
premises.evidence_span: Everyone can sign up for free and create presentations. We offer plans for individuals and teams

value.text: Easy collaborative presentation work that looks great in any setting
value.evidence_span: We make it easy to work together on presentations
